bin_semantics: source bin [bin_start,endpoint); endpoint is bin end; endpoints in (window_end-W,window_end]; window_end=decision_tick-2min; available_at=endpoint+delay; first changed bin_start=event.start
sr_score: maximum over valid features of abs(X[j]-train_median[j]) / max(train_q90[j]-train_q10[j],0.05), train statistics use valid rows; validity bits excluded; no empirical-CDF-only proxy
calibration_policy: one envelope cut per model/recipe/W/seed from normal calibration only, all group x C1/5/15 guards simultaneously; strict >; candidates union(global quantile grid, maximum per-group/C q.99 minimum cut), at most8; evaluate every candidate because episode counts need not be monotone; no later recalibration
suite: A:60 intended events per evaluation split, predetermined source_unknown/late/unseen-category crosses retained in denominator
primary_event_metric: new episode onset in [actual event.start,event.end), one-to-one; confirmed_start only marks early subset, early is included in actual-onset primary
cadence_policy: one-minute causal as-of feature trace, score latest endpoint on each decision grid; all source bins retained; same reference/threshold/input/raw/pred at common15min ticks; actual preprocessing and model-score costs reported separately
selection_policy: selection only, three-seed pooled intended-event and false-alarm/occupancy/coverage/cost table; freeze one recipe/W per algorithm or report no winner before blind; no blind-based reselection
scope_limit: research-only aggregate simulation, no real customer semantics/labels/SLA and no frozen-v12 quality reproduction
